headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a 15-1 victory, led by Tyler Tolbert's 5-hit performance. The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, thanks to José Caballero's 2 home runs and 4 RBIs. The Washington Nationals overcame a 5-run deficit to defeat the Houston Astros 11-12, with CJ Abrams contributing 3 hits and 3 RBIs.

Several key players have been affected by injuries, including Byron Buxton, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hip strain. Konnor Griffin, David Hamilton, and Brandon Lockridge have also been placed on the injured list, while Max Rajcic has been transferred to the 60-day injured list. Martín Pérez and Brandon Woodruff have been placed on the 15-day injured list.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several players changing teams. Matt Seelinger has been traded from the Detroit Tigers to the New York Mets for cash, while Woo-Suk Go has been traded from the Detroit Tigers to the Minnesota Twins. Ryan Degges has been traded from the Philadelphia Phillies to the Cleveland Guardians, and Tom Cosgrove has been traded from the Houston Astros to the Washington Nationals.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a lopsided 15-1 victory. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with a 5-hit performance, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by José Caballero's impressive performance at the plate. Caballero hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs, while Cam Schlittler pitched 8 strong innings with 8 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Nationals Come from Behind to Win 11-12**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals overcame a 5-run deficit to defeat the Houston Astros 11-12 in a thrilling matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought 7-6 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brooks Raley earning the win and Luke Weaver securing the save. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a narrow win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Christian Yelich and Jake Bauers contributing key hits in the game. Jacob Misiorowski earned the win for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Buxton Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins center fielder Byron Buxton has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hip strain, effective retroactive to July 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire Right-Hander Matt Seelinger**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash.
